title: Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer — Medical Devices

requirements.text: Developed embedded firmware in C and C++ for production devices
Worked closely with ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers at the register and peripheral level
Built firmware on top of a real-time operating system, managing tasks, scheduling and timing constraints
Performed board bring-up on new hardware and read schematics to debug issues
Debugged hardware and firmware using an oscilloscope and logic analyser
Developed software under medical device regulation such as IEC 62304 or FDA Class III submissions
Followed a safety-critical software development lifecycle such as DO-178C, including traceability and verification artifacts
Earned a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or computer engineering
Implemented DSP algorithms and signal filtering on resource-constrained hardware
Worked with wireless protocols such as BLE or MICS for device telemetry
